edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: Both statements are from the same USA Today article and report the same 10% fare increase effective October 1.

edges.label: refines
edges.reason: The anchor states the service is generally 'affordable', while the new statement specifies that 'discounted fares will remain available' for eligible passengers. This is a narrower detail of affordability. Origin is not mentioned in the quotes themselves.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, USA Today reported ““Tri-Rail continues to provide an important and affordable transportation option for residents, commuters and visitors traveling throughout the region,” Diane Hernandez Del Calvo, SFRTA Deputy Executive Director, said in the release.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “Still, discounted fares will remain available for "eligible passengers," including students and senior citizens.”.

On 2026-10-01, USA Today reported “The South Florida Regional Transportation Authority published a press release advising riders that the Tri-Rail would increase its fares by 10% starting Oct. 1, a change that was approved by the organization's governing board in June.”; on the same day, USA Today reported “The South Florida Regional Transportation Authority published a press release advising riders that the Tri-Rail would increase its fares by 10%, effective Oct. 1.”.
